en: This is a sepia-toned or black and white vintage postcard showing a waterfront view of a historical town with whitewashed, cubic buildings typical of Greek island architecture. A prominent small church with a dome and a distinct facade can be seen at the center. The scene is tranquil, with a few people and possibly a small boat in view. The text at the bottom is in both Greek and French, with an additional website watermark.
